motions.purpose: Show how altitude, eccentricity, and inclination change a Moon-centered Keplerian orbit.
motions.model: Two-body Keplerian orbit about the Moon using JPL mean radius and gravitational parameter.
motions.limitations: Omits mascons, high-degree gravity, third-body perturbations, maneuvers, attitude, and terrain collision.
motions.reducedMotion: Render a fixed phase at 18% of the orbit and retain all metrics.
motions.exportState: Freeze at progress 0.18 and hide controls.
motions.accessibility: The figure has a concise model summary; controls use labels and keyboard-operable native elements.
